The '''unincorporated Bosphian provinces''' was an informal sector of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[New Territories]]<ref name="New Territories" /> that contained the [[Bosph system]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[Ueda system]] during the [[High Republic Era]], a [[time]] when most of the Outer Rim was independent of representation in the [[Galactic Republic]]. The Ueda system in [[Standard Galactic Grid]] square Q-3 was the home of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] and its [[moon]] [[Uedar]]. Ueda was at one point the site of lucrative [[Wood|logging]] and milling operations, with [[Pirate|marauders]] striking at the world for its processed materials.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Ueda had become a signatory into the Republic within the last eighty [[Standard year|years]] and the operations had ceased.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In that year,<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|traveled]] to Ueda and [[Indara's murder|murdered]] the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> in [[Point Ueda]]. [[Currency|Currencies]] in use on Ueda at that [[time]] included [[Galactic Credit Standard|Republic dataries]] and [[Bosphian sestertius]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Empire]] over a hundred years later, the provinces had been formally incorporated as the [[Bosph sector]].<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-31.png|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-31}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unincorporated Bosphian provinces appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The sector then identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Author [[Jason Fry]] later confirmed that the provinces and the Bosph sector, which was recanonized by the "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix of star systems, were one and the same.<ref name="Fry" />
